Thanks — got the workbook. High-level: we support SCCs and the UK IDTA (we publish our standard UK Addendum), and we operate a TIA/DTIA evidence stream that maps to the items in your sheet. I can outline the sources of each artifact and the expected cadence in the next message after I loop in Legal and Product Ops.

Quick notes up front:
- Subprocessor CSV is generated daily and we can provide a signed snapshot on request (see Transfer-Controls-Inventory.csv).
- Residency / routing: for EU customers we have optional onshore endpoints (VPC/private deployment) and a documented fallback routing table; I’ll surface the exact nodes for HealthNova.
- Audit cadence: we typically provide operational logs monthly, registry attestations quarterly, and independent SOC/third-party attestations annually — but we can tailor to customer needs where contract requires tighter windows.

Looping in Laura (legal), Kimberly (ops) and Naomi (privacy engineering) to confirm the artifacts and timelines.

Thanks for the ping. Reviewed HealthNova’s matrix and attached a draft of Redwood_DPA_v3.1_redlines.docx with proposed language referencing: 1) operational evidence delivery (define monthly export of transfer logs in CSV/JSON with sample schema), 2) registry attestations (quarterly) and 3) obligation to provide SOC/third-party report annually or upon customer reasonable request.

A few contract-level notes:
- I recommend committing to "monthly operational exports" (scoped to tokens+routing metadata) rather than a live stream to limit exposure.
- For the UK Addendum: add clause clarifying that for EU customers with UK-resident controllers, Redwood will declare any UK-only processing nodes and provide a documented fallback routing plan. That addresses their residency question without exposing internal topology.
- Subprocessors: agree to provide a dated CSV snapshot within 3 business days of request and a notification window of 30 days for material changes.

Kimberly/Naomi — please confirm the feasibility and expected delivery windows in the next 24 hours so I can finalize redlines for Sean to send to HealthNova. If acceptable, I’ll attach the redlined DPA and a short cover note for procurement.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
